transcript: Hi everyone, I hope you all are doing good. I just wanted to update you guys about my personal life which is not well. A lot really happened. Yesterday it was so sudden that we had to rush to hospital and my brother was crying all of the day because the Jashree's father, like my uncle Chachu, is not well. He always wanted good for everyone and supported, helped people out there. And I just wonder, like why always horrible things happen to really good people out there? While covering the Jashree's book, I was really very sad because I could remember all those moments out there. And yes, Shiro brings a joy and hope to our lives. Now we were really very worried. So yes, we had to visit hospital and seeing their people crying for their loved ones made me really very unhappy, like sad. And I remember health should be the first priority. Always spend quality time with your family members, your loved ones. Never have ego in your life.
metadata_caption: Horrible things happen to really good people | A day in my life🏥 #shorts #family
